description: Lists every state in the GreenLight plug-in (balcony) solar registry with its legal status, law name, power cap, and verification state, plus a count of entries by verification state. Takes no input. GreenLight records enacted law only, verified field-by-field against the enrolled bill text; entries still marked pending are under review and unconfirmed. A state not listed is simply not in the registry; that says nothing about its law. The registry is not legal advice.
name: solar_states
title: List plug-in solar registry states
